brief.notes: Standalone Scenario 06 (Bioskop Tanpa Pintu), 2026-11-23. Owner approved narasi.txt verbatim and requested two visual-hygiene fixes, now applied. Location-as-anomaly premise: one unified 1970s cinema auditorium that rebuilds everything it made (seats, aisles, side and back doors) and always grows away from the screen; the only original fixtures are the fabric screen, the low stage and the projector beam. No creature, ghost, mimic or imitator appears. Engine triple-branch-rewind; 24 real panels; pipelineVersion 2. narasi.txt is 241 canonical words (241 if split) per scripts/count-narration-words.mjs, inside the 225-245 band. Hook: 'Bioskop ini nggak punya pintu.' (5 canonical words), trim fallback drop 'ini' logged in the brief and authorised for Agent 02. Provisional runtime 154.0 s / 4620 frames at 30 fps; provisional branchRewinds at frames 1653, 2265 and 2736 (12 frames each), dread silence frames 2748-2790, blackout frame 4611. Every timing in brief.md is story order only and is superseded by audio-edit-map.json. Panel layout: P01-P05 setup, P06-P07 Loop 1, P08-P09 Loop 2, P10-P11 Loop 3, P12-P18 realization/stage/push, P19 backstage, P20 gate insert, P21 duck-out, P22 brick payoff, P23 final line, P24 gate-slam jolt. All 24 panels are single-vantage plates; there is no black plate. Final tail is 1.5 s after the final spoken word: 150 ms vacuum, 1.05 s gate-slam jolt + shake/flash, 0.3 s procedural black. Loop 1 death: red KELUAR doors at the back of the hall open onto the balcony edge (fall). Loop 2 death: the side fire exit opens onto a rebuilt left balcony ledge, so momentum carries him over; mid-fall he sees the lit flashlight gone from the aisle seat and the screen hem unchanged. Loop 3 death: killing the projector removes the room's only straight reference and the rows in front grind backward, crushing him against the balcony. Winning escape: walk north into the beam footprint, climb the 0.6 m stage, push through the loose bottom hem and corner tear of the screen, cross backstage 6 m stage-right, out the open alley roll-up gate into cold dawn; at the alley corner the cinema's rear wall is solid brick where the red doors would surface. Motif 'Ikutin cahayanya.' is the father's own line to his nervous daughter, reused as his decision, recontextualised at the close ('Kali ini, kamu nggak jatuh.'). Ownership scope: only files under episodes/006-bioskop-tanpa-pintu/ were written; arc.json untouched, no commit made. Next: Agent 02 one-shot Investigator master and Agent 03 24-panel batch. No listening or visual review has been performed.
